request.description: Starts a loan application (case) as a draft, creating or reusing the borrower profile. If the person has an open lead, it is converted and linked (`leadId`), and the CA working it is credited. Borrower context only. Borrower context (the applicant's own records, reached through their login); partner context sees applications its firm filed (M3c). Lists and reads never show other people's records.

response.name: 201 Created
